name: transforming growth factor beta receptor associated protein 1

function.text: TGFBRAP1 is the approved symbol for transforming growth factor beta receptor associated protein 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in SMAD binding; transforming growth factor beta receptor binding; endosomal vesicle fusion.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TGFBRAP1 encodes transforming growth factor beta receptor associated protein 1. Its functions include SMAD binding and transforming growth factor beta receptor binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TGFBRAP1 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
